data.name: CsoListClearTitle
data.comment: Dialog title and its confirming button

data.name: CsoListClearWarning
data.value: This action will delete all Connected System Objects from JIM.

data.name: CsoListClearExplain1
data.value: Clearing does not touch the external system. It discards the Connector Space objects, their Metaverse joins, and any Pending Exports to this Connected System; the Metaverse itself is not changed by the clear.

data.name: CsoListClearExplain2
data.value: Run a Full Import to rebuild the Connector Space. At the first Full Synchronisation after that import completes successfully, Metaverse values contributed by objects that did not return are recalled automatically. Each Metaverse object's type Deletion Rule is then applied for objects that did not return, with its configured grace period.

data.name: CsoListClearExplain3
data.value: Note: A Full Synchronisation run before then does nothing beyond ordinary synchronisation. The reconciliation refuses, leaving everything as it was, if far fewer objects return than were cleared; re-import the rest, or raise the allowed share in Service Settings, then run a Full Synchronisation again.

data.name: PexPageInfo
data.value: A Pending Export is a change JIM has queued for a Connected System and not yet confirmed: the object it applies to, the attribute changes it carries, and how its attempts have gone.

data.name: PexNewObject
data.comment: Shown when the target object does not exist yet

data.name: PexAttemptsAgain
data.value: JIM attempts it again at every export run.

data.name: PexUnresolvedIntro
data.value: These reference values have not been written to the Connected System yet. Everything else on this Pending Export is written as soon as it can be; each reference is written when the object it refers to can be addressed in this Connected System.

data.name: PexExplainResolvable
data.value: The referenced object now has an anchor in this Connected System. The reference is written on the next export run.

data.name: PexExplainAwaitingAnchor
data.value: The referenced object exists in this Connected System but does not carry an anchor yet. Its own export has not been executed or confirmed. The reference is written once it has.

data.name: PexExplainNotInSystem
data.value: The referenced object has no Connected System Object in this Connected System. It is out of scope for every Synchronisation Rule into this system, or has not been provisioned. The reference cannot be written until it is.

data.name: PexNoChangesDelete

data.name: PexNotFound
data.value: This Pending Export is no longer queued. It has either been exported to the Connected System, or been superseded by a later change to the same Connected System Object. Pending Exports are removed once they are no longer waiting to be applied, so links to an individual one stop resolving after its export runs.
data.comment: Info alert when the export is gone
